**Finding submitted: deviation (medium severity, term-termination).**

The renewal mechanic sits in Article IV.I (p0049), not Article VIII. It provides that "The Agreement may be renewed for an additional period of seven (7) years at the option of the Licensor" — a unilateral, multi-year extension at the Vendor's sole discretion, with no Licensee consent right, no non-renewal notice window, and no cap on renewal pricing. That is in our walk-away zone, and it also conflicts with Article IV.II/III of the same paragraph, which contemplate extension only by mutual written agreement.

Redline (validated, preferred level): replaced that sentence with successive twelve-month renewals by mutual written agreement, plus a renewal fee increase cap at the lesser of CPI and 3%. Fallback offered in the comment: automatic twelve-month renewals with a 60-day opt-out and a 5% cap.
